items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...'35 with Alexander. '36 with Ziggy and, (unintelligible) Alexander, we played New Year's Eve... [INTERVIEWEE] That's right Alexander, that's right.

ctx.x: Wait a minute, '34, S. H. Dudley, '35, -- '35 with Alexander. '36 with Ziggy and, (unintelligible) Alexander, we played New Year's Eve...
And he did that thing on the bandstand, with one of the brother's wives, he got a little carried away.
